subject.title: [Bug]: z.ai endpoint auto-detection probe sends no User-Agent → z.ai 429s it, detectZaiEndpoint returns null, Coding Plan onboarding fails

question: Which linked Z.AI User-Agent fix should be treated as canonical, and should live after-fix Coding Plan proof be required or explicitly waived before merge?
rationale: The code fix shape is narrow, but multiple open PRs compete for the same issue and this review environment lacks a real Z.AI Coding Plan key for live proof.

options.title: Land one tested canonical PR
options.body: Choose one focused PR with header regression coverage, require redacted live proof or explicitly waive it, and close the duplicate candidates after it lands.

options.title: Wait for live provider proof
options.body: Keep all candidate PRs blocked until a contributor or maintainer supplies a redacted real Z.AI Coding Plan endpoint-detection run.

options.title: Waive proof for a minimal patch
options.body: Accept the issue reporter's live before-fix evidence plus source-level coverage, but still land only one duplicate fix path.

recommendation.title: Land one tested canonical PR
recommendation.body: Choose one focused PR with header regression coverage, require redacted live proof or explicitly waive it, and close the duplicate candidates after it lands.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the feature history for Z.AI endpoint auto-detection and is the current assignee on this issue.
